dedupe_keys.name: chinapv 10m 2024 vector map of utility scale and rooftop pv plants in china

description: ChinaPV-10m-2024 is a 10 m resolution vector map of utility-scale and rooftop photovoltaic plants across China for the year 2024. It was published on Zenodo in May 2026 by Bin Zhang of East China Normal University, with a companion journal paper. The map was produced with a framework that combines a customised hybrid genetic algorithm for feature selection with a LightGBM classifier applied to multi-temporal Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery, with a reported overall accuracy of 95.16%. Each polygon represents an installation and carries estimated installed capacity, annual electricity generation and avoided carbon dioxide emissions computed with provincial grid emission factors. The model framework, image preprocessing and post-processing code are released alongside the data. Coverage is China. The data are an ESRI shapefile in WGS-84, in a zipped archive of about 1.5 GB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: capacity and generation are estimates, not registry values, and classification errors remain. Simulation uses are hazard exposure of solar assets to wind, hail or flood, spatial energy planning and distributed generation studies. Related records: data-global-power-plant-database lists larger plants worldwide.
